items.statement: Within the computed gas-phase descriptor boundary, the result supports the authors' qualitative explanation of the methylsulfanyl substrate's anomalous oxidation behavior.
items.expected: The report connects substantial sulfur localization and the higher 2g benzylic C–H BDE to a plausible, limited explanation of lower aldehyde-forming propensity, while explicitly stating that descriptors alone do not prove the full reaction mechanism.
